source.title: Tulevaisuusselonteon 2. osa: Nuoret tulevaisuuden tekijöinä
source.titleSv: Framtidsredogörelsens andra del: Unga som framtidsformare

brief.fi: Valtioneuvoston tulevaisuusselonteon toinen osa käsittelee nuoria tulevaisuuden tekijöinä, painopisteenä 15–24-vuotiaat. Selonteko kokoaa tutkimus- ja asiantuntijatietoa sekä nuorten omia kokemuksia tulevaisuususkoa, osallisuutta ja yhteiskunnallista osallistumista koskien. Se tunnistaa politiikkatoimia ja toimintasuuntia, joilla nuorten hyvinvointia, luottamusta ja vaikutusmahdollisuuksia vahvistettaisiin pitkäjänteisesti yli vaalikausien. Selonteko ei ole laki tai määräys, ja sen toimet edellyttäisivät erillisiä päätöksiä.
brief.sv: Statsrådets framtidsredogörelse, del två, behandlar unga som framtidsformare, med fokus på personer i åldern 15–24 år. Redogörelsen sammanställer forskning, expertkunskap och ungas egna erfarenheter om framtidstro, delaktighet och samhällsengagemang. Den identifierar politiska åtgärder och inriktningar för att långsiktigt stärka ungas välbefinnande, tillit och inflytande över valperioder. Redogörelsen är inte en lag eller förordning, och åtgärderna förutsätter separata beslut.
brief.en: Part II of the Finnish Government Report on the Future focuses on young people as makers of the future, particularly those aged 15 to 24. The report compiles research, expert knowledge and young people’s own experiences on faith in the future, inclusion and societal participation. It identifies policies and measure directions to strengthen young people’s wellbeing, trust and influence consistently beyond electoral terms. The report is not law or a regulation, and its measures would require separate decisions.

Part II of the Government Report on the Future
Young People as Makers of the Future
Publications of the Finnish Government 2026:74
Publisher Finnish Government
Group author Prime Minister’s Office
Language Finnish Pages 70
Abstract
The Finnish Government has chosen young people as makers of the future as the theme
of Part II of the Government Report on the Future. The report brings together up-to-
date research and expert knowledge as well as young people’s own experiences related
to faith in the future, inclusion and societal participation. The focus is particularly

on
young people aged 15 to 24. The report has been prepared in consultation with young
people already involved in decision-making structures as well as with those whose
voices often go unheard.
The building blocks of young people’s faith in the future and trust are everyday safety
and security, belonging to communities, smooth education, training and employment
paths, and the experience that they are being heard and that their views matter. The
report identifies policies and paths for measures that can strengthen young people’s
wellbeing, inclusion and faith in the future beyond electoral terms.
